rules.statement: spelling, grammar, and capitalization fixes are applied directly in place (Oxford comma in lists of 3+, MLA title case for headers); the only audit category applied directly, everything else goes in the report
example proposals are 'Bad / Good / Why' blocks: bad version, good version beside it, one-sentence caption under each
one 'Call-out quote' report item per post section, none skipped, each a one-sentence quote distilling the section thesis
flag links not in [label](url) form and code-block lines over 80 characters; the 80-character limit applies to code blocks only
every source in a '## References' section at the bottom, letter keys in order of first citation, entries of the form '- **[A]** [Source - Title](url)'
inline citations as '[A](#ref-a)' after the claim, with multi-claim sentences grouped in one parenthesis at sentence end
report skeleton is numbered sections with lettered items (1. category -> 1.a finding); every finding exactly one lettered item, never bare bullets or prose
each proposed fix includes an example or concrete suggestion
locations referenced by description or quoted snippet, never line numbers
the report states how each '> EDITOR:' directive was resolved

excluded.reason: role/goal statement (expert editor, engagement without dilution); no artifact shape to violate
fact-check every claim (web + repo docs, repo match can still be wrong) is compliance-cost verification work the agent skips under pressure; pressure-testing track, retrieval-covered
flag structural problems and ambiguous subjects/referents is evaluation guidance with no competing output shape
propose illustrations and analogies for complex concepts is evaluation guidance with no competing output shape
repetition audit three-criteria evaluation (incl. Gotcha restatement) is evaluation guidance with no competing output shape
resolve each '> EDITOR:' line and remove/rewrite the marker is task work, not output shaping; its report element is the Audit report resolution rule
the bare-URL/footnote prohibition restates the positive recipes covered by the references-section-form and inline-citations entries
only-copyedits-applied-without-asking restates Workflow step 2, covered by copyedit-in-place
repo-match-can-still-be-wrong restates the Workflow fact-check rule; pressure-testing track
checklist items restate body rules already inventoried
